questionText:
Read the following case study on the fashion lifecycle and retail merchandising and answer the questions that follow:

An apparel retail chain, Trendz India, prepares its commercial spring merchandise plan. The fashion merchandiser analyzes how diverse fashion trends move through the five stages of the classic 'Fashion Cycle':
1. Introduction: Avant-garde metallic cargo skirts debut on Paris luxury runways; worn by celebrity fashion innovators and photographed in Vogue.

topic: Fashion Acceptance Spectrum from Niche to Mass
questionText:
Arrange these fashion tiers in descending order of exclusivity and craftsmanship:
(A) Haute Couture (exclusive, bespoke, hand-crafted one-of-a-kind garments)
(B) Designer / Bridge RTW (high-end luxury ready-to-wear with designer prestige)
(C) Mass Market Ready-to-Wear (standardized industrial garments manufactured in large volumes)
(D) Discount / Budget Fast Fashion (low-cost, rapid turn-around copies sold at low price points)

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: B, A, C, D
